metadata.name: PublicUrl
metadata.description: One public address an application is reached at: an http or https origin the host routes to a port, with the request's host and path unchanged.

url.description: The address: an http or https origin — a host and an optional port, with no path, query or credentials.

port.description: The key of the root's `ports:` this address is served on, a `tcp` port.

primary.description: Marks the application's main address. At most one per application.

customDomains.description: Lets the host route further domains to this need's port, ones the application is never told about. At most one per port.
